d: For weeks, Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz put nearly half of India's oil supply at risk — and even with a ceasefire now in place, the damage is far from undone. Oil markets don't recover overnight, LPG cylinders are still hard to find, and families across India are feeling the squeeze in their kitchens and at the pump. In this video, we break down exactly how a war thousands of kilometres away reached into Indian homes — and why the return of peace on paper doesn't mean the pain stops anytime soon. Because the hard truth is, India has been dangerously dependent on foreign oil for…
